name: verumsignal-mcp
description: Rated political claims from debates, press conferences and the news, with who said each one.
long_description: Search rated political claims from debates, press conferences and news coverage, see what is being rated live, and get every rated claim from a debate, each with who said it and a link to its page. Requires a Verum Signal API key.

tools.name: search_claims
tools.description: Search rated claims about a topic, or by one speaker, from debates, press conferences and the news in one call, each with its rating, who said it and a link.

tools.name: list_event_claims
tools.description: List rated claims from every public debate and press conference, filtered by topic, speaker, event type, rating and date, with a cursor.

tools.name: live_now
tools.description: Whether a debate or press conference is being covered live, with its newest rated claims, or the next listed event.

tools.name: list_recent_claims
tools.description: Claims reported by news outlets, with their ratings, searchable by topic.

tools.name: get_debate_verdicts
tools.description: Every rated claim from one debate, with the speaker, the rating and whether it is still provisional.

tools.name: list_debates
tools.description: Available debates with claim counts, dates and status.

tools.name: get_api_status
tools.description: How much the corpus holds, what it covers and how current it is.

api_key.title: Verum Signal API key
api_key.description: Your API key (vs_live_...). Get one at https://verumsignal.com/developers
